title: Analyst maintains Overweight rating on JPMorgan, nudges price target
summary: A sell-side analyst reiterated an Overweight rating on JPMorgan Chase and slightly adjusted the price target, citing steady net interest income and capital return. No change to estimates.

title: Bank stocks little changed as investors await CPI and next week's Fed decision
summary: Large-cap bank shares were mixed in a quiet session with no company-specific catalysts, as markets waited for inflation data and the upcoming Federal Reserve meeting.
